title: One storyline or sets of texts
statement: Is knowledge better built by one continuous storyline across lessons or by sets of texts on one topic?
detail: A course audit against a meeting's directives agreed only in part with the request for narrative continuity across lessons: building knowledge first is not the same as one forced storyline, and the audit judged sets of passages on one topic the better unit, a push-back to be documented rather than a settled answer. Elsewhere in the same project one unit runs a single story across several lessons, and a simulated review passed it on a criterion for a coherent single-topic text set.

evidence.quote: Knowledge-first ≠ a single forced storyline; topic-coherent passage sets are the better unit
L5 is the second part of a single continuous Peter Pan narrative; the Fantasy Classics unit theme holds.
